chapter.heading: Shepherd the Flock
chapter.v:
The elders
who are among you I exhort, I who am a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that will be revealed: [Luke 10:18;]

and when
the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory that does not fade away.Submit to God, Resist the Devil [Rev. 6:6 f Rev.]

Likewise you
younger people, submit yourselves to your elders. Yes, all of you be submissive to one another, and be clothed with humility, for“God resists the proud,But gives grace to the humble.” [[Rev. 9:10;]

Therefore humble
yourselves under the mighty hand of God, that He may exalt you in due time, [Job 3:21; 7:15;]

casting all
your care upon Him, for He cares for you. [Joel 2:4 k Nah.]

Be sober,
be vigilant; because your adversary the devil walks about like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour. [Joel 1:6]

Resist him,
steadfast in the faith, knowing that the same sufferings are experienced by your brotherhood in the world. [Jer. 47:3; Joel]

But may
the God of all grace, who called us to His eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.

To Him
be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.Farewell and Peace

By Silvanus,
our faithful brother as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand. [Rev. 8:13;]

She who
is in Babylon, elect together with you, greets you; and so does Mark my son. [Rev. 8:3]

Greet one
another with a kiss of love.Peace to you all who are in Christ Jesus. Amen. [Gen. 15:18;]
